{{Quote|Millennium Falcon, this is Zark Two. The Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet demands that you bring to a dead stop your vessel. Stand by for boarding.|Zark Two|<ref name="Swarm War" />}}
'''Zark Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] for the second member of [[Zark Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]].<ref name="Swarm War" />
